csharpCode: using UnityEngine; using Zombera.World.Roads; using System.Collections.Generic; public class CheckJct2 { public static string Run() { var sb = new System.Text.StringBuilder(); var builder = Object.FindObjectOfType<CityPrefabRoadNetworkBuilder>(); var field = typeof(CityPrefabRoadNetworkBuilder).GetField("_lastGeneratedRoadNetwork", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic); var net = field.GetValue(builder); var roadsProp = net.GetType().GetProperty("Roads"); var roads = (System.Collections.IList)roadsProp.GetValue(net); var jctSet = new HashSet<Vector2>(); foreach (var r in roads) { var ptsField = r.GetType().GetField("pointsXZ"); var pts = (System.Collections.IList)ptsField.GetValue(r); if (pts.Count < 2) continue; jctSet.Add((Vector2)pts[0]); jctSet.Add((Vector2)pts[pts.Count-1]); } var jctList = new List<Vector2>(jctSet); var rl = GameObject.Find("Road Lamps"); if (rl == null) return "no lamps"; var buckets = new Dictionary<int,int>(); foreach (Transform t in rl.transform) { Vector2 lp = new Vector2(t.position.x, t.position.z); float minD = float.MaxValue; foreach (var j in jctList) { float d = Vector2.Distance(lp, j); if (d < minD) minD = d; } int bucket = ((int)(minD / 5f)) * 5; if (!buckets.ContainsKey(bucket)) buckets[bucket]=0; buckets[bucket]++; } var keys = new List<int>(buckets.Keys); keys.Sort(); foreach (var k in keys) sb.AppendLine(k + "-" + (k+5) + "m: " + buckets[k]); return sb.ToString(); } }
